components.gap: The handbook does not state or prove the source's Boolean-algebra Lemma 6: for B = r.o.(P), P the Prikry order over a normal kappa-complete ultrafilter D on measurable kappa ((t,B) <= (s,A) iff t end-extends s, B subset A, range(t-s) subset A), for every partition {a_alpha : alpha<lambda}, lambda<kappa, of some a in B and every (s,A) in P there are A' subset A with A' in D and alpha<lambda such that (s,A') <= a_alpha; nor the consequence that B is (aleph_0,lambda)-distributive for every lambda<kappa, using countable completeness of D. The P6 forcing-language decision lemma and no-new-bounded-subsets theorem (transitive ground M, external generic) are nearby results, not this Boolean-algebra claim. Owed: statement and complete proof of Lemma 6 and of the distributivity consequence, with the measurable-cardinal assumption kept ambient and every cardinal qualification, together with the cited proof dependency Jech 1978 pp.470-471 (not held).
